Run the `spec-intake` skill (`.agents/skills/spec-intake/SKILL.md`) for feature `p2-m-integration-governance-iam-sod-and-provisioning` (`Story: P2-M` in `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`).

### Source Specification & Milestone Row (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`)
- **Milestone**: `P2 — MVP / Core Features`
- **Milestone file**: `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
- **Story ID**: `P2-M`
- **User story (copy verbatim from milestone row)**:
  `As a platform administrator, I want zero-role onboarding requests to submit IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION tickets to governance, governance decisions to enforce maker-checker Segregation of Duties conflict matrices via IamSodEvaluationPort, and ticket approvals to grant user role assignments atomically via IamRoleGrantPort, so that access provisioning and ticket approvals strictly obey production SoD rules.`
- **Feature artifact**: `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-m-integration-governance-iam-sod-and-provisioning.md`
- **Dependency**: `P2-C, P2-H`
- **Surface**: `backend`
- **Size**: `6` (`AC-1` through `AC-6`)
- **Material**: `no`

### Relevant Accepted Cross-Story Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`)
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
- `L-003`: Define dedicated port value types (`com.example.app.iam.port` / `com.example.app.governance.port`) on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities across peer bounded contexts enforced by ArchUnit.
- `L-004` & `L-005`: Annotate refusal-auditing or synchronous-audit-emitting service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
- `L-008`: Expose a package-private accessor method (`other.jdbcTemplate()`) on `@Repository` classes when copying `JdbcTemplate` references so the CGLIB proxy forwards the call to the target bean.
- `L-010` & `L-012`: Normalize `": "` to `":"` or match optional whitespace around the colon (`"\"fieldName\"\\s*:\\s*..."`) when parsing fields from PostgreSQL `JSONB` columns read as text (`governance_tickets.proposed_payload_json`).
- `L-011`: Call `TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` before rethrowing `ContractProblemException` inside `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` services when a cross-context port call (`IamRoleGrantPort`) fails mid-transaction so partial DB writes roll back cleanly.

### Instructions
1. Inspect existing code in `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/iam/` and `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/governance/` (specifically `IamSodEvaluationPort`, `IamRoleGrantPort`, `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort`, `UserAccessService`, `SodConflictEvaluator`, `GovernanceTicketWorkflowService`, `GovernanceTicketSubmissionService`, etc.), as well as `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-k-integration-governance-execution-freeze-archive.md` and `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-l-integration-governance-configuration-cutover.md` to understand the exact codebase conventions and requirement structure. Do NOT write a `.helper-brief.md` file — inspect the codebase directly using your read/grep/find tools.
2. Draft `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-m-integration-governance-iam-sod-and-provisioning.md` following `spec-intake` and matching the exact structure and rigor of `p2-l-integration-governance-configuration-cutover.md`:
   - Title: `# Feature: P2-M — Cross-Context Integration: Governance <-> IAM Segregation of Duties & Role Provisioning`
   - Metadata lines under title:
     `Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features`
     `Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
     `Story: P2-M`
     `Surfaces: backend`
     `Material: no`
   - `## User story`: Exact sentence from milestone `P2-M`.
   - `## Acceptance criteria`: 6 Gherkin scenarios (`AC-1` through `AC-6`, matching milestone `Size: 6`), covering:
     - `AC-1` (`Kind: happy`): Submit `PENDING_APPROVAL` `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` governance tickets from `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications` via `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort` after `IamSodEvaluationPort.evaluateRoleAssignment` validation (covering zero-role newly onboarded operators and access-expansion operators, storing `requestedRoleIds`, `justification`, and optional `expiresAt` in `proposed_payload_json`, recording `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_CREATED` and `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED`, and leaving `user_role_assignments` unchanged until approval).
     - `AC-2` (`Kind: happy`): Enforce maker-checker Segregation of Duties conflict matrices (`MAKER_CHECKER_SAME_PRINCIPAL` and `ROLE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION` in `sod_conflict_rules` across requester and approver / target roles, strict in prod and respecting `enforce_in_non_prod` in non-prod) via `IamSodEvaluationPort` on governance ticket decisions (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/endorse`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reassign`).
     - `AC-3` (`Kind: happy`): Atomically provision user role assignments via `IamRoleGrantPort.grantRolesFromTicket` inside the `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` transaction for `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` tickets (re-verifying `IamSodEvaluationPort.evaluateRoleAssignment` against the requester's current active roles union `requestedRoleIds` at approval time, inserting/updating active `user_role_assignments` linked to `source_ticket_id = ticket.id` and `assigned_by_user_id = approverUserId` with optional `expires_at`, incrementing user `version`, recording `IAM_USER_ROLES_UPDATED` and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED` in `audit_log_entries`, and returning `HTTP 200 OK` `GovernanceTicketResponse` with `status = "APPROVED"` and updated `ETag`).
     - `AC-4` (`Kind: edge`): Preserve existing `user_role_assignments` untouched when an `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` ticket is rejected (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reject`) or cancelled (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel`), and roll back partial DB writes (`TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` per `L-011`) if `IamRoleGrantPort` fails mid-transaction during `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` (e.g., target user deactivated or role soft-deleted/conflicting since submission) while preserving `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED` audit entries when an SoD violation is detected at approval time (`L-004`).
     - `AC-5` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse unauthenticated callers (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`), unauthorized callers (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` + `AUTHZ_DENIED`), BOLA unauthorized cancellations (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` + `AUTHZ_DENIED`), maker-checker self-approvals/self-endorsements (`403 SOD_MAKER_CHECKER_VIOLATION` + `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), `IamSodEvaluationPort` role-matrix conflicts (`403 SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED` + `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), and `View-As` mutations (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` + `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`).
     - `AC-6` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` submissions or ticket approvals on inactive/deactivated requester user accounts, unknown/inactive/soft-deleted requested roles, past `expiresAt` timestamps, duplicate open `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` tickets or `Idempotency-Key` payload mismatches (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT` / `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_CONFLICT`), stale `If-Match` headers (`412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`), or already-terminal tickets (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`).
   - `## Preconditions`, `## Desk check`, `## Out of scope`, `## NFRs`, `## Security-review triggers` (including sensitive actions), `## Regulations`, `## Open questions` (`none`), and `## Delivery approvals` (empty table header only, no approved rows yet).
3. Do NOT write `<feature>.phase-result.md` and do NOT run `sync-feature-state.sh`. Return a summary once `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-m-integration-governance-iam-sod-and-provisioning.md` is written and verified against the `spec-intake` checklist.

### Requirements Summary
- **User Story**:
  > As a platform administrator, I want zero-role onboarding requests to submit IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION tickets to governance, governance decisions to enforce maker-checker Segregation of Duties conflict matrices via IamSodEvaluationPort, and ticket approvals to grant user role assignments atomically via IamRoleGrantPort, so that access provisioning and ticket approvals strictly obey production SoD rules.
- **Metadata**: `Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features`, `Story: P2-M`, `Surfaces: backend`, `Material: no`, `Open questions: none`
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` through `AC-6`, `3` happy, `1` edge, `2` negative)**:
  - **AC-1 (`Kind: happy`)** — Submit `PENDING_APPROVAL` `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` governance tickets from `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications` via `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort.submitRoleApplicationTicket` after `IamSodEvaluationPort` validation while keeping `user_role_assignments` unchanged until maker-checker approval.
  - **AC-2 (`Kind: happy`)** — Enforce maker-checker Segregation of Duties conflict matrices (`MAKER_CHECKER_SAME_PRINCIPAL` and `ROLE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION` in `sod_conflict_rules`, `100%` in production and respecting `enforce_in_non_prod` in non-production) via `IamSodEvaluationPort.enforceNoSodConflict` on `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/endorse`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`, and `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reassign`.
  - **AC-3 (`Kind: happy`)** — Atomically grant user role assignments via `IamRoleGrantPort` inside the `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` transaction for `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` tickets (re-verifying `IamSodEvaluationPort` across active roles union `requestedRoleIds` at approval time, inserting/updating `user_role_assignments` with `source_ticket_id = ticket.id` and `assigned_by_user_id = approver.userId`, incrementing user `version`, recording `IAM_USER_ROLES_UPDATED` and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED`, and returning `HTTP 200 OK` with `status = "APPROVED"` and updated `ETag`).
  - **AC-4 (`Kind: edge`)** — Preserve `user_role_assignments` untouched on ticket rejection or cancellation, roll back partial DB writes (`TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` per `L-011`) on non-SoD role-grant failure during `approve`, and commit `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED` audit entries (`L-004`) when an SoD conflict is detected at approval time.
  - **AC-5 (`Kind: negative`)** — Refuse unauthenticated callers (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`), unauthorized callers and BOLA cancellations (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` + `AUTHZ_DENIED`), maker-checker self-decisions/self-reassignments (`403 SOD_MAKER_CHECKER_VIOLATION` + `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), `IamSodEvaluationPort` role-matrix conflicts (`403 SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED` + `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), and `View-As` mutations (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` + `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`).
  - **AC-6 (`Kind: negative`)** — Refuse role application submissions or approvals on missing (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) or deactivated (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`) users, unknown/inactive/soft-deleted roles or past `expiresAt` (`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`), duplicate open `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` tickets or terminal tickets (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), `Idempotency-Key` payload mismatches (`409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_CONFLICT`), and stale `If-Match` headers (`412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`).
- **Security Triggers & Regulations**:
  - **Triggers**: `RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive maker-checker role application & approval actions.
  - **Regulations**: BSP Circular 982 / 1019, Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR, and Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §11, §12 & VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10).
